# Atlas Logistics Enterprise ERP

> Next-Generation Supply Chain Management, Operations Cockpit, and Multimodal Transport ERP.

## Capabilities & Workflows
- [Operations Cockpit 2.0](/cockpit): Prioritized actionable inbox with explainable attention scoring and in-situ execution.
- [Shipment 360](/shipment-360): End-to-end multimodal timeline, events, documents, and container tracking.
- [Freight Rate Comparer](/quotes): Ocean FCL/LCL, Air Freight, and Port Drayage Last-Mile quoting with GLEC ISO 14083 emissions.
- [Customs Clearance](/customs): DUA clearance, bonded warehouse, USMCA cross-border, e-BL smart contracts, and PKI audit.

## API Documentation
- [Health Status](/api/health): Service, SQLite WAL database, and queue telemetry.
- [Operations API](/api/scm/v1/operational/cockpit): Real-time actionable operational items and work item lifecycle.
- [Freight Rates API](/api/rates): Live carrier rates, fuel adjustments (BAF), and surcharge comparisons.
- [Addresses Directory](/api/addresses): UN/LOCODE hub directory and warehouse geocoding.
